title: Grove: Too Dark Alarm
intro: A light sensor, a buzzer and an LED: when it gets too dark, the light comes on and the alarm beeps.

steps.title: How bright is it?
steps.text:
The Light Sensor is in analog port **A1**. Brighter light gives a bigger number.

**Your task:** run it, open the Serial Monitor, and cover the sensor (in the simulator, drag the light slider down).
hints: The light slider is next to the drawing.
Dark gives a small number, bright a big one.
Try both ends of the slider.

checks.label: The number goes down when I cover the sensor

steps.success: Your board can tell how bright it is.

steps.title: Sound the alarm
steps.text:
`tone(BUZZER_PIN, 880)` plays a note (880 beats a second). `noTone(BUZZER_PIN)` stops it. `DARK` is a **constant**: one number you can change in one place.

**Your task:** fill in the two comments.
hints: Each line goes under its comment.

checks.label: The LED comes on when dark
Covering the sensor sets off the alarm

steps.success: Your alarm works. Real ones use the same idea.

outro: You read a Grove **light sensor**, made a decision with **if / else**, and used **tone** for an alarm.
stretch: Make the beep go faster the darker it gets.
Only sound the alarm after it's been dark for 3 seconds.
Show the light level on the Serial Plotter.
